== Biography ==
Rebecca was born in 1805. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-653|Joseph Glasgow]] and [[Glasgow-876|Nancy Glasgow]]. She passed away in 1857.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

Joseph’s reported 1820 Ohio death is compatible with the birth, but no original relationship passage is transcribed.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.
